subject: general
question: Who among the following gave the famous 'Do or Die' slogan during Quit India Movement?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Mahatma Gandhi__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Mahatma Gandhi gave the** famous 'Do or Die' slogan during the Quit India Movement.** 
 
• The Quit India Movement was a significant movement **launched **by the Indian National Congress **on August 8, 1942**, demanding an end to British rule in India.
 
• The** 'Do or Die'** slogan emphasized the urgency and determination of the Indian people to achieve independence. 
 
• Gandhiji is known as the Father of our Nation.
 
• He returned to India from South Africa on 9th January 1915 and celebrated it as **Pravasi Bharatiya Divas (NRI Day)**.
 
• The first satyagraha of Gandhiji is Chamapran Satyagraha (1917) also known as the first civil disobedience movement.
 
• The first hunger strike of Gandhiji is Ahmedabad Mill Strike (1918).
 
• The first non-cooperation movement of Gandhiji is Kheda Satyagraha (1918).
 
• He was the president of the INC session in Belgaum (1924).
 
• In 1931, Gandhiji participated in the Second Round Table Conference in London.
 
• Gandhiji was assassinated on 30 January 1948 by Nathuram Godse and observed as 'Martyrs Day'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Abul Kalam Azad** 

 
 
• He was the first Education Minister of India.
 
• He also contributed to the establishment of educational institutes like Jamia Millia Islamia and IIT Kharagpur.
 
• He strongly advocated education for women and free and compulsory primary education for children up to the age of 14.
 
• He was awarded with Bharat Ratna in 1992 posthumously.
 
 
 
• **Jawaharlal Nehru**
 
 
• He was the first prime minister of India and was one of the most prominent leaders of the Indian independence movement.
 
• Jawaharlal succeeded **Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel**, who was President in 1928-1929.
 
• His father Motilal Nehru was an Indian lawyer, activist and politician belonging to the Indian National Congress.
 
• He also served as the Congress President twice, 1919–1920 and 1928–1929.
 
• He was a patriarch of the Nehru-Gandhi family and the father of Jawaharlal Nehru, the first Prime Minister of India.
 
 
 
• **Subhash Chandra Bose**
 
 
• He was born on 23rd January 1897, in Cuttack, Orissa Division, Bengal Province.
 
• The birth anniversary of Netaji on 23rd January is celebrated as 'Parakram Diwas'.
 
• He is popularly known as 'Netaji'.
 
• He passed the Indian Civil Services Examination in 1920 in England but left it on Gandhiji's call of the Non-cooperation Movement.
 
• He was the first elected INC President at the Haripura Session in 1938 and Tripuri Session in 1939.
 
• He founded the Forward Bloc in 1939 and Kisan Sabha.
 
• The first division of INA was formed in September 1942 with the help of Japan.
